text:
alex-chen: Quick sync — we need to align on geo-routing policy, tenant isolation levels, and explicit launch gates for the next quarter. TL;DR: a couple large customers are pushing for data-sovereignty + per-tenant SLAs, ops is worried about cost fragmentation. I sketched an MVP scope and gates below. Comments?

maria-velasquez: +1. My take: define three isolation tiers (shared, isolated-pool, VPC/on-prem). For Q2 MVP we offer shared + isolated-pool with soft quota enforcement and explicit pricing. VPC/on-prem (full tenancy) deferred to Q3.

ryan-k: Important to call out cost multiples: isolated-pool looks ~2.5–3x unit cost vs shared due to reserved GPUs and lower statistical multiplexing. We need a clear pricing sheet and an optional autoscale/burst flow to control spend.

samir-patel: From infra perspective we can implement region-aware routing + fallback. Suggest a policy language like: 
```yaml
policy: 
  - match: tenant.location == "EU"
    route: eu-pool
    fallback: global-us
  - match: tenant.tier == "isolated"
    route: isolated-pool-{tenant_id}
    enforce_quota: true
```
That would let us express residency + per-tenant pool routing. Need to discuss how we surface "enforce_quota" and bill for shortfalls.

tia-ops: Proposed launch gates (must pass all for Q2 public rollout):
- Telemetry: incoming requests carry region/routing headers in >=95% of requests for top 10 tenants (we can gate earlier for pilot tenants)
- SLA: 99.9% availability for shared routes; isolated pools must meet defined throughput SLOs (can be softer during canary)
- Perf regression: no >5% median latency regression on routed traffic vs baseline
- Canary: 10% traffic to new routing for 48h with automatic rollback on error spikes
- Runbook + automated fallback test executed in staging and once in prod during maintenance window

maria-velasquez: For enterprise customers asking for residency + 99.9% read SLA we need legal/contract language and an onboarding checklist (data mapping, IP allowlists, KMS integration). Sales needs a carrier doc for price and lead time.

ryan-k: Also recommend exposing cost-control knobs per-tenant: max-burst, default quantization profile, and an "economy" route that applies lower-cost quantization automatically. That reduces churn for internal ops.

samir-patel: Infra checklist for productizing routing + isolation:
- control-plane: add policy-store, versioning, rollout APIs
- runtime: consistent-hash updates, KV-cache affinity by tenant, per-pool metrics tagging
- scheduler: reserved-slot accounting for isolated pools, preemption policy for shared workers
- observability: per-tenant tokenized cost/latency, top-of-stack traces for cross-region hops
- migration: transparent reroute plan + stateful KV sync docs

infra-bot: deploy-bot: NOTE: planned infra freeze for migration window on 1797740000 UTC — keep that in mind for rollout timing.

tia-ops: Prioritization/Scope note: MVP must include routing policy engine + telemetry + billing hooks + docs. Defer fine-grained tenant networking (VPC peering) and custom model pinning to Phase 2. We should ship a clear migration playbook for customers who want to move from shared->isolated.

alex-chen: Agree. My proposed product priority list for Q2: 1) Policy engine + UI + API, 2) Telemetry & SLA monitoring, 3) Isolated pool implementation + pricing, 4) Canary/rollback orchestration, 5) Docs/contract templates for sales. Defer VPC and on-prem to Q3.

maria-velasquez: Customer ask backlog: bank-a (EU residency + 99.9% read SLA), medco (data residency + audit logs), adtech customer (low-latency APAC routing). Recommend we slot bank-a for pilot on isolated-pool.

ryan-k: Action: I'll draft the pricing model and add cost-estimator to the console. Estimate: 2 engineering sprints for autoscale + 1 sprint for billing integration.

samir-patel: Action: infra will prototype the policy-store + routing plugin next sprint; will include a small hack-day spike for KV-cache affinity.

tia-ops: Action: I'll write the canary playbook + rollout checklist. Will own the runbook for rollback and cross-region failover test.

alex-chen: Sounds good. I'll convert this into a short PR (roadmap + launch gates + MVP scope) and tag in sales and legal. Q2 target if we hit engineering cadence. Thanks all :thumbsup:
